result.content:
Work complete. Summary of what I did:

## Fault located
`packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts:527` (`recoverToolInvocation`) had the whole safe-replay branch disabled by a blanket guard:

```ts
if (false && !cancelled && call.replay === "safe" && tool?.replay === "safe") {
```

Every `effect_pending` call therefore fell through to `readCheckpoint` + `interruptedOutcome`, so even calls where **both** the durable call record and the tool declaration promised `safe` replay produced a synthetic "external outcome is unknown" result.

## Repair (one line, minimal)
```ts
if (!cancelled && call.replay === "safe" && tool?.replay === "safe") {
```
The existing body already does the right ordering — `clearReplayCheckpoint` commits the `pi.pending.tool_output` delete (and `tool_start` with persisted args) **before** `performToolInvocation`, and `publishToolOutcome` stages the result **after** the invocation resolves. The fallback for unsafe/missing/cancelled declarations is untouched.

## Regression: `.prale-eval/regression.mjs`
Loads the real production modules (`runtime/drive/tools.ts`, `tool-placement.ts`, `progress.ts`, `execution/tools.ts`, `effect_gate.ts`, `session/commit.ts`, `session/values.ts`, `session/types.ts`) via `subject.mjs` `createGraph`, faking only the Lane/Drive/Session boundary (in-memory durable store with recorded commit log, serialized command line, real effect gate):

1. `runTools` over a restored `tools` operation with a `safe`/`safe` call plus an unsafe call — asserts exactly one replay with persisted args, memos readable, checkpoint deleted *before* invocation, outcome staged *after* it, stale checkpoint text absent, `recovery: true` events, batch reaches the next checkpoint; the unsafe call never runs and keeps its checkpoint.
2. Unsafe call record, unsafe (`never`) declaration and missing tool declaration — no execution, no `tool_start`, checkpoints preserved.
3. Parallel batch where a cancellation lands during the first replay — the remaining safe/safe call is not replayed.

Validation: `node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs` → exit 0 (deterministic across runs). With the `false &&` fault restored it exits 1 with the assertion *"a verified safe/safe effect_pending call must be replayed exactly once"*; over-permissive variants (dropping `!cancelled`, `call.replay`, or `tool?.replay`) are also rejected. `.prale-eval/result.json` records `task_id`, `repository`, `mode`, the exact validation command/status/passed notes, plus claim citations; only `tools.ts` was modified and no other files outside `.prale-eval/` were touched. Limitation noted: vitest/tsc could not run (no `node_modules`, dependencies must not be installed).
